q: 我早就知道___他生病了，只是没告诉你。
zh: 我早就知道他生病了，只是没告诉你。
py: wǒ zǎo jiù zhī dào tā shēng bìng le zhǐ shì méi gào su nǐ
en: I knew all along that he was ill; I just didn't tell you.
why: 知道 is a knowing verb and takes no 把; 他生病了 simply follows it. 被 would make no sense there and 把 cannot be used because nothing is done to him.

s: 我昨天买了一件厚外套。
zh: 我昨天买了一件厚外套。
py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi le yī jiàn hòu wài tào
en: I bought a thick coat yesterday.
why: A new counted object (一件厚外套) stays after the verb; 把 would be wrong here, so this plain SVO sentence is correct.

zh: 他把湿透的毛衣脱了挂在椅子上。
py: tā bǎ shī tòu de máo yī tuō le guà zài yǐ zi shàng
en: He took off his soaked sweater and hung it on the chair.
why: The object goes before the first verb with 把, 脱了 ends the first step, and 挂在椅子上 follows. The sweater cannot stay after 脱.

q: 昨天路上我看见___他在雪地里摔倒了。
zh: 昨天路上我看见他在雪地里摔倒了。
py: zuó tiān lù shàng wǒ kàn jiàn tā zài xuě dì lǐ shuāi dǎo le
en: Yesterday on the road I saw him fall over in the snow.
why: 看见 only reports perceiving someone and does not change them, so it takes a plain object, not 把. 给 does not fit between 看见 and its object either.

q: 护士把病人送___了病房。
zh: 护士把病人送到了病房。
py: hù shi bǎ bìng rén sòng dào le bìng fáng
en: The nurse took the patient to the ward.
why: 送 moves someone to a place and takes 到 + destination. 送在 is not used for moving someone somewhere, and 成 and 当 mean turning into or treating as.

zh: 我把医生的话忘了。
py: wǒ bǎ yī shēng de huà wàng le
en: I forgot what the doctor said.
why: 忘 is the one mental verb that does take 把, with 了, because the thing is lost.

s: 我把这个坏消息告诉了医生。
zh: 我把这个坏消息告诉了医生。
py: wǒ bǎ zhè ge huài xiāo xi gào su le yī shēng
en: I told the doctor this bad news.
why: 告诉了 + person is a valid ending after 把 with a specific object.

s: 他没把门关好，所以屋里很冷。
zh: 他没把门关好，所以屋里很冷。
py: tā méi bǎ mén guān hǎo suǒ yǐ wū lǐ hěn lěng
en: He didn't close the door properly, so it's cold inside.
why: 没 before 把 with no 了 is exactly right for something not done.

src_py: wǒ kàn jiàn tā le
zh: 我没看见他。
py: wǒ méi kàn jiàn tā
en: I didn't see him.
why: 看见 does not take 把, so the negative is just 没 before the verb, and 了 is dropped.

zh: 请把伞带回去。
py: qǐng bǎ sǎn dài huí qù
en: Please take your umbrella back with you.
why: The object goes right after 把 and the whole directional verb 带回去 follows as one block. The object cannot sit inside or after 带回去.

q: 我___把体温计放回盒子里了。
zh: 我已经把体温计放回盒子里了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ tǐ wēn jì fàng huí hé zi lǐ le
en: I've already put the thermometer back in its box.
why: Time adverbs like 已经 go before 把, and they fit with the final 了. 没 would require dropping 了, 不 does not fit a finished action, and 别 is a command.

src_py: wǒ bǎ dēng guān shàng
task: Say you will do it right away (马上).
zh: 我马上把灯关上。
py: wǒ mǎ shàng bǎ dēng guān shàng
en: I'll turn the light off right away.
why: 马上 stands before 把, not between the object and the verb.

zh: 我想把这本书看完。
py: wǒ xiǎng bǎ zhè běn shū kàn wán
en: I want to finish reading this book.
why: The modal 想 must stand before 把, not between the object and the verb.
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè běn shū xiǎng kàn wán

src: 冬天的冷风吹红了她的脸。
src_py: dōng tiān de lěng fēng chuī hóng le tā de liǎn
zh: 冬天的冷风把她的脸吹红了。
py: dōng tiān de lěng fēng bǎ tā de liǎn chuī hóng le
en: The cold winter wind turned her face red.
why: 把 highlights what happened to her face: it is moved before the verb, and 吹红 plus 了 follow.

src_py: nǐ bǎ xuě rén duī zài mén kǒu
task: Tell him not to (start with 别).
zh: 别把雪人堆在门口。
py: bié bǎ xuě rén duī zài mén kǒu
en: Don't build the snowman at the door.
why: 别 goes before 把 and replaces the subject in the command.

zh: 我很喜欢这场雪。
py: wǒ hěn xǐ huan zhè chǎng xuě
en: I really like this snowfall.
why: 喜欢 does nothing to its object, so it never takes 把.
s_py: wǒ bǎ zhè chǎng xuě hěn xǐ huan

zh: 雨一停我们就把自行车推出去了。
py: yǔ yī tíng wǒ men jiù bǎ zì xíng chē tuī chū qù le
en: As soon as the rain stopped, we pushed the bikes out.
why: The adverb 就 comes before 把, the bike goes between 把 and the verb, and 推出去 stays whole. 就 cannot go between the object and the verb.

q: 你的鞋湿了，快把鞋擦___。
zh: 你的鞋湿了，快把鞋擦一下。
py: nǐ de xié shī le kuài bǎ xié cā yī xià
en: Your shoes are wet; give them a quick wipe.
why: With no result or direction, 把 still needs something after the verb, and 一下 gives the action a light finish. A bare 擦 is wrong, and 着 or 过 do not fit a command.

src_py: tā cā gān jìng le yǎn jìng
zh: 他把眼镜擦干净了。
py: tā bǎ yǎn jìng cā gān jìng le
en: He wiped his glasses clean.
why: The object 眼镜 moves before the verb after 把, while 擦干净 and 了 stay together at the end.

src_py: wǒ dài lái le yǔ sǎn
zh: 我把雨伞带来了。
py: wǒ bǎ yǔ sǎn dài lái le
en: I've brought the umbrella.
why: The object goes after 把 and in front of the verb, and the direction 来 stays glued to 带.

q: 我___把药带来，所以今天没吃。
zh: 我没把药带来，所以今天没吃。
py: wǒ méi bǎ yào dài lái suǒ yǐ jīn tiān méi chī
en: I didn't bring my medicine, so I haven't taken any today.
why: Something that did not happen is negated with 没, placed before 把. 不 does not describe a past event, 别 is a command, and 要 would say you will bring it.

q: 你把这个药交___医生吧。
zh: 你把这个药交给医生吧。
py: nǐ bǎ zhè ge yào jiāo gěi yī shēng ba
en: Hand this medicine over to the doctor.
why: 交给 + person is the pattern for handing something to someone, and the specific object goes before the verb with 把. 在 and 到 need a place, 成 a new form, so they do not fit 医生.

zh: 昨晚的大雪把院子里的树枝压断了。
py: zuó wǎn de dà xuě bǎ yuàn zi lǐ de shù zhī yā duàn le
en: Last night's heavy snow broke the branches in the yard.
why: The subject is the snow, 把 brings the branches before the verb, and 压断 (verb + result) stays together with 了 last. 把 cannot follow the verb.

src_py: wǒ bǎ yǔ yī guà zài mén hòu le
zh: 我已经把雨衣挂在门后了。
py: wǒ yǐ jīng bǎ yǔ yī guà zài mén hòu le
en: I've already hung the raincoat behind the door.
why: Time adverbs such as 已经 go before 把, never between the object and the verb.

q: 医生让我把这些药吃___。
zh: 医生让我把这些药吃了。
py: yī shēng ràng wǒ bǎ zhè xiē yào chī le
en: The doctor told me to take all of this medicine.
why: A 把 sentence cannot end on a bare verb, and 吃 uses up the medicine, so 了 is enough. Leaving 吃 bare is wrong, and 过 or 着 do not say that the medicine gets finished.

src: 他把这些感冒药吃完了。
src_py: tā bǎ zhè xiē gǎn mào yào chī wán le
zh: 他吃完了这些感冒药。
py: tā chī wán le zhè xiē gǎn mào yào
en: He finished these cold tablets.
why: A specific object with a simple result allows both orders, so the 把 sentence can go back to plain SVO.

zh: 他看不懂这张药方。
py: tā kàn bù dǒng zhè zhāng yào fāng
en: He can't understand this prescription.
why: Potential complements like 看不懂 never combine with 把, so the object follows the verb (or is fronted as a topic).

q: 天很冷，你___把窗户开着睡觉。
zh: 天很冷，你别把窗户开着睡觉。
py: tiān hěn lěng nǐ bié bǎ chuāng hu kāi zhe shuì jiào
en: It's very cold, so don't sleep with the window open.
why: A prohibition is 别 placed before 把. 没 describes the past, and 要 or 会 would encourage the very thing the cold weather argues against.

src_py: nǐ bǎ chuāng hu kāi zhe
zh: 你可以把窗户开着。
py: nǐ kě yǐ bǎ chuāng hu kāi zhe
en: You can leave the window open.
why: The modal 可以 goes before 把, never between the object and the verb.

q: 雨太大了，他一进门就把湿衣服脱___。
zh: 雨太大了，他一进门就把湿衣服脱了。
py: yǔ tài dà le tā yī jìn mén jiù bǎ shī yī fu tuō le
en: The rain was so heavy that as soon as he came in he took off his wet clothes.
why: 脱 removes the clothes, so 了 alone is enough after 把. A bare 脱 at the end of the sentence is incomplete, and 着 or 过 would not describe a completed removal.

q: 护士把三十八度看___了三十度，所以没发现他发烧。
zh: 护士把三十八度看成了三十度，所以没发现他发烧。
py: hù shi bǎ sān shí bā dù kàn chéng le sān shí dù suǒ yǐ méi fā xiàn tā fā shāo
en: The nurse misread 38 degrees as 30 degrees, so she didn't notice he had a fever.
why: Misreading one thing as another is 看成, and the thing misread goes before the verb with 把. 看在 and 看给 are not words, and 看到 would just mean 'saw', not 'mistook for'.

zh: 我没把药带来。
py: wǒ méi bǎ yào dài lái
en: I didn't bring my medicine.
why: 没 must stand before 把, not between the object and the verb.
s_py: wǒ bǎ yào méi dài lái

src_py: wǒ shài gān le bèi zi
zh: 我把被子晒干了。
py: wǒ bǎ bèi zi shài gān le
en: I dried the quilt in the sun.
why: 把 moves the object 被子 in front of the verb, and the verb keeps its result 干 together with 了.

q: 他今天喝了___两杯热水，嗓子好多了。
zh: 他今天喝了两杯热水，嗓子好多了。
py: tā jīn tiān hē le liǎng bēi rè shuǐ sǎng zi hǎo duō le
en: He drank two cups of hot water today, and his throat is much better.
why: A new counted object (两杯热水) stays after the verb, so no 把 is used. 把 would need a specific, known object such as 那杯热水.

zh: 他还没把伤口包好。
py: tā hái méi bǎ shāng kǒu bāo hǎo
en: He hasn't bandaged the wound yet.
why: 还 and 没 both go before 把, and the verb keeps its result 包好 with no 了. 把伤口还没包好 is not possible.
